bcm53xx: add support for ASUS RT-AC3200 and ASUS RT-AC5300
ASUS RT-AC3200 and ASUS RT-AC5300 are AC3200 and AC5300 routers,
respectively, featuring 5 Ethernet ports over the integrated Broadcom
switch.

ASUS RT-AC3200 hardware info:
* Processor: Broadcom BCM4709A0 dual-core @ 1.0 GHz
* Switch: BCM53012 in BCM4709A0
* DDR3 RAM: 256 MB
* Flash: 128 MB
* 2.4GHz: BCM43602 3x3 single chip 802.11b/g/n SoC
* 5GHz: BCM43602 3x3 two chips 802.11a/n/ac SoC
* Ports: 4 LAN Ports, 1 WAN Port

ASUS RT-AC5300 hardware info:
* Processor: Broadcom BCM4709C0 dual-core @ 1.4 GHz
* Switch: BCM53012 in BCM4709C0
* DDR3 RAM: 512 MB
* Flash: 128 MB
* 2.4GHz: BCM4366 4x4 single chip 802.11b/g/n SoC
* 5GHz: BCM4366 4x4 two chips 802.11a/n/ac SoC
* Ports: 4 LAN Ports, 1 WAN Port

Flashing instructions:
* Boot to CFE Recovery Mode by holding the reset button while power-on.
* Connect to the router with an ethernet cable.
* Set IPv4 address of the computer to 192.168.1.2 subnet 255.255.255.0.
* Head to http://192.168.1.1.
* Reset NVRAM.
* Upload the OpenWrt image.

CFE bootloader may reject flashing the image due to image integrity check.
In that case, follow the instructions below.

* Rename the OpenWrt image as firmware.trx.
* Run a TFTP server and make it serve the firmware.trx file.
* Run the URL below on a browser or curl.
  http://192.168.1.1/do.htm?cmd=flash+-noheader+192.168.1.2:firmware.trx+flash0.trx
|}} ===Flashing Tomato=== ====Flashing FreshTomato ARM7 2019.4==== Upload via [https://www.asus.com/support/FAQ/1000814/ firmware restoration utility], after it seems like endless reboot. wait for lan lights to flash twice, the do a [[Project:DD-WRT/Hard reset or 30/30/30|30-30-30 reset]] using WPS button as reset button. Using the actual reset button for a 30-30-30 will put it in recovery mode. ==Pictures==
'''from SmallNetBuilder''' File:Asus_RT-AC3200_top.jpg|Top File:Asus_RT-AC3200_inside.jpg|Inside File:Asus_RT-AC3200_board.jpg|Board top
[[Has images::internal| ]] ==Notes== When using WINscp change the file protocol from SFTP to SCP to connect. ===Recovery/Rescue Mode=== Set up the Router Rescue Mode Take [RT-AC68U] as an example Unplug the router's power cord. Press the Reset button. Keep long pressing the Reset button and plug the cord to DC IN at the same time. Notice: Please DO NOT release the Reset button until the Rescue Mode is enabled. The router turns to the Rescue mode when you see the power indicator light is slowly flashing. ==See also== :[[List of Tri-Band Wireless Devices]] *[[ASUS RT-AC5300]] *ASUS RT-AC3200 *[[ASUS RT-AC3100]] *[[ASUS RT-AC2900]] *[[ASUS RT-AC1900]] [[Category:English Documentation]]
